result.reason: The operative language does not reach either playbook position. It adds the desired Vendor indemnity triggers, but does not expressly limit them to third-party claims, impose a duty to defend, or provide the standard notice, control, and cooperation procedure. It also leaves Client’s indemnity substantially broader than the permitted Customer-content and breach-of-law scope. Nor does it satisfy the fallback, because it omits the customary IP exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies, and 3× annual-fees super-cap. The edit is confined to the indemnity allocation and generally preserves unrelated intent, but it retains an unnecessarily broad Vendor indemnity for any contractual breach and contains awkward drafting, including the duplicated “harmless” formulation. The margin comment cannot cure these operative omissions.
